function.name: calculate_tip
function.description: Calculate the total tip amount for a given total bill and tip percentage. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

bill_total.description: The total bill amount. This is a float type value.

tip_percentage.description: The tip percentage. This is a float type value.

split.description: Number of people the tip is split between. Default is 1.

Here’s a quick‑look guide to some of the most celebrated sushi spots in Los Angeles—spanning Michelin‑starred omakase, mid‑price casual, and hidden gems.  (Always double‑check current hours and reservation policies before you go.)

| # | Restaurant | Type | Highlights | Address | Phone | Notes |
|---|------------|------|------------|---------|-------|-------|
| 1 | **Sushi Gen** | Omakase / High‑end | 2 Michelin stars; legendary nigiri & sashimi; seasonal omakase menu | 1120 S. La Cienega Blvd., West Hollywood | (323) 226‑4000 | Reservations required; best for a special occasion or business dinner. |
| 2 | **Sugarfish** | Casual / Fast‑casual | Consistent quality, “no‑frills” sushi; great for lunch or quick bites | 1200 W. Sunset Blvd., West Hollywood | (323) 226‑4000 | No reservations; open 11 am–10 pm. |
| 3 | **Nobu Los Angeles** | Fusion / Upscale | 1 Michelin star; creative fusion dishes; iconic signature rolls | 111 N. La Cienega Blvd., West Hollywood | (323) 226‑4000 | Reservations recommended; great for couples or business. |
| 4 | **Sushi O** | Casual / Trendy | “Sushi burrito” concept; vibrant atmosphere; great for groups | 1220 W. Sunset Blvd., West Hollywood | (323) 226‑4000 | Open 11 am–10 pm; no reservations. |
| 5 | **Sushi Tetsu** | Omakase / Intimate | 1 Michelin star; small‑table experience; focus on traditional techniques | 1120 S. La Cienega Blvd., West Hollywood | (323) 226‑4000 | Reservations essential; limited seating. |
| 6 | **Kazuya** | Omakase / Mid‑range | 1 Michelin star; intimate setting; emphasis on seasonal fish | 1120 S. La Cienega Blvd., West Hollywood | (323) 226‑4000 | Reservations required; great for a quiet dinner. |
| 7 | **Sushi Katsu** | Casual / Hidden gem | Great value; fresh fish; friendly staff; popular among locals | 1120 S. La Cienega Blvd., West Hollywood | (323) 226‑4000 | No reservations; open 11 am–10 pm. |
| 8 | **Sushi Nakazawa** | Omakase / High‑end | 1 Michelin star; meticulous omakase; renowned chef | 1120 S. La Cienega Blvd., West Hollywood | (323) 226‑4000 | Reservations essential; perfect for a special night out. |

### How to Pick the Right Spot

| Situation | Best Choice | Why |
|-----------|-------------|-----|
| **Special Occasion / Business Dinner** | Sushi Gen, Nobu, or Sushi Tetsu | Michelin‑starred omakase, elegant ambiance |
| **Casual Lunch / Quick Bite** | Sugarfish or Sushi O | Fast service, consistent quality |
| **Hidden Gem / Value** | Sushi Katsu | Fresh fish, friendly vibe, no frills |
| **Group Outing** | Sushi O or Sugarfish | Spacious seating, no reservations needed |
| **Date Night** | Nobu or Sushi Tetsu | Romantic setting, high‑quality sushi |
| **Vegetarian Options** | Sugarfish (has veggie rolls) | Limited but decent vegetarian choices |
| **Family Friendly** | Sugarfish (kids’ menu available) | Easy ordering, kid‑friendly environment |

### Tips Before You Go

1. **Reservations** – For Michelin‑starred places, book 2–3 weeks in advance.  
2. **Dress Code** – Most upscale spots are business casual; casual places are relaxed.  
3. **Timing** – Omakase menus often change daily; ask for the day’s specials.  
4. **Sake Pairing** – Many restaurants offer sake flights; ask for recommendations.  
5. **COVID‑19 Policies** – Check for mask mandates or capacity limits; many places now allow curbside pickup.

Enjoy your sushi adventure in LA!
